    The same four moves,
    every engagement.

    Scope creep usually means nobody agreed what "done" looked like. So we fix that first, then build in the open.

    1. Move 01

      Take it apart

      I map the current system end to end — where attention enters, where it leaks, what a person actually does at each step. You get the diagram whether or not we work together.

    2. Move 02

      Prove the risky bit

      The hardest mechanic gets built first as a rough working thing, not a slide. If the simulation, the automation or the demo can't carry it, we find out in week one.

    3. Move 03

      Build in the open

      A live link from day one, recorded walkthroughs at each milestone. You watch it become the thing instead of waiting for a reveal.

    4. Move 04

      Hand over the keys

      Documented, narrated, editable by your team. Every project ships with the walkthrough that explains how it works to whoever inherits it.
